verdict.rationale: Rootly documents status pages, including private ones, built to communicate service health to internal stakeholders. It also documents workflow automation that updates stakeholders, which together give non-responders structured incident information outside the incident channel. Nothing in the evidence shows a subscription mechanism. Missing for 10: documented stakeholder subscription (email/Slack opt-in to incident updates), detail on the structure of update templates, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, internal stakeholders get structured incident updates they can subscribe to, without joining the war room

citations.quote: Status pages allow you to quickly communicate information about the health of your services and applications to internal stakeholders and external customers.
Rootly has two types of status pages available: public status pages and private status pages.
Automation that runs your response: channels created, stakeholders updated, tickets filed, retros started, the same way every time.
